items.title: Security: COMMAND_INJECTION in commands.py:974 (subprocess shell=True)
items.desc:
**Vulnerability:** COMMAND_INJECTION
**File:** aider/commands.py:974
**Severity:** Critical

**Vulnerable code:**
subprocess.run("git " + args, shell=True)

**Why it's dangerous:**
User-controlled git args passed to shell=True
→ /git status; cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa possible
→ SSH key theft

**Fix:**
subprocess.run(["git"] + args.split(), shell=False)

**How I found it:**
pip install aina-scan
aina-vibeguard scan .

Found in 3 seconds.
Happy to submit a PR.

We ran a professional security scan (ChatGPT security review) against our fork of ZeroClaw at a frozen revision and identified **15 findings**: 5 were already fixed upstream (we ported them with source attribution), and **10 remain unpatched upstream**.
